prioritized_findings.title: Neutral usage Extra writes strand successful rotation indefinitely
prioritized_findings.remediation: Use a refresh/lifecycle/routing revision independent of neutral telemetry; preserve credential/owner/lifecycle/routing CAS and non-replay evidence.
prioritized_findings.regression: Real successful issuer barrier + real neutral usage update; successor durable, one consumption, no pending block.

prioritized_findings.title: Fresh bearer forwarded using stale identity and proxy snapshot
prioritized_findings.classification: concrete source correctness/security defect; actual exposure unmeasured
prioritized_findings.remediation: Carry a single revision-validated credential/routing snapshot into HTTP and WebSocket forwarding or deny/reselect on mismatch; preserve separate shadow scheduling identity.
prioritized_findings.regression: Select old row then commit identity/proxy reconnect before bearer selection; observe actual wire tuple.

prioritized_findings.title: Refresh-token non-replay evidence is scoped to account ID
prioritized_findings.classification: concrete source security/correctness defect conditional on duplicate/reimported credential material
prioritized_findings.remediation: Canonical credential owner or unique durable keyed token-identity digest across account IDs, retaining uncertainty across deletion/recreation.
prioritized_findings.regression: Two IDs sharing one fabricated refresh token, including reimport after uncertainty; no second issuer consumption.

prioritized_findings.title: Credential parent admission incorrectly applies direct scheduling vetoes
prioritized_findings.remediation: Separate durable credential-parent admission from direct-account scheduling; keep genuine disabled/deleted/pending/shared-cooldown rejection.
prioritized_findings.regression: Real selection/token path with paused, global-limited and overloaded parent must preserve independent shadow success.

prioritized_findings.title: Manual PAT/access-only refresh bypasses validation and enrichment
prioritized_findings.remediation: Explicit manual PAT validation/access-only enrichment branch with durable metadata CAS; keep rotating issuer refresh claimed.
prioritized_findings.regression: Observe validator call, invalid-PAT failure and fresh metadata from a fabricated coordinator endpoint.
